name: sim_analytic_geometry_clausen_scholze_constraint_canonical
description: Clausen-Scholze analytic geometry with ring constraints, sheaf conditions, and rigid embedding verification via cvc5

pytorch.reason: pytorch not needed; pure symbolic/algebraic computation via cvc5 and sympy

pyg.reason: PyG not needed; analytic geometry handled algebraically

z3.reason: z3 not needed; cvc5 handles all SMT constraint proofs

cvc5.reason: Used for QF_LIA analytic ring and sheaf constraint proofs

sympy.reason: Used for embedding verification and de Rham comparison

clifford.reason: Clifford algebra not needed; analytic rings via cvc5/sympy

geomstats.reason: geomstats not needed; p-adic geometry handled symbolically

e3nn.reason: e3nn not needed; no SO(3) equivariance required

rustworkx.reason: rustworkx not needed; no graph structure

xgi.reason: xgi not needed; no hypergraph structure

toponetx.reason: toponetx not needed; standard algebraic computations sufficient

gudhi.reason: gudhi not needed; no persistent homology required

test_1_analytic_ring.name: analytic_ring_structure
test_1_analytic_ring.setup: A = analytic ring, A^+ = ring of integers
test_1_analytic_ring.claim: A^+ is a subring of A containing topologically nilpotent elements

test_2_sheaf_condition.name: sheaf_condition_structure_sheaf
test_2_sheaf_condition.setup: X = analytic space, U, V = open sets, O_X = structure sheaf
test_2_sheaf_condition.claim: O_X(U ∪ V) must satisfy sheaf gluing condition

test_3_tate_embedding.name: tate_rigid_embedding
test_3_tate_embedding.setup: Rigid analytic spaces over Q_p embed into analytic spaces
test_3_tate_embedding.claim: embedding is fully faithful (bijective on morphisms)

test_1_ring_failure.name: analytic_ring_not_ring_unsat
test_1_ring_failure.claim: violation: A^+ is closed under + but not under *

test_2_sheaf_violation.name: sheaf_gluing_unsat
test_2_sheaf_violation.setup: O_X is structure sheaf on analytic space X
test_2_sheaf_violation.claim: violation: gluing condition fails for open U, V
test_2_sheaf_violation.constraint: assert_not((has_sheaf_property and dim(O_X(U_union_V)) == dim(O_X(U)) * dim(O_X(V))) or (not_sheaf))

test_3_nilpotent_violation.name: topological_nilpotent_unsat
test_3_nilpotent_violation.setup: A^+ = ring of topologically nilpotent elements
test_3_nilpotent_violation.claim: violation: x ∈ A^+ but x is not topologically nilpotent
test_3_nilpotent_violation.constraint: assert_not((x_in_A_plus and not_top_nilpotent) or (x_in_A_plus implies top_nilpotent))

test_1_unit_disk.name: unit_disk_restricted_power_series
test_1_unit_disk.setup: D = unit disk in Q_p, O(D) = Z_p{{T}}
test_1_unit_disk.claim: sections O(D) form the ring of restricted power series Z_p{{T}}

test_2_de_rham.name: de_rham_comparison_boundary
test_2_de_rham.setup: X = smooth proper rigid space over Q_p
test_2_de_rham.claim: de Rham cohomology equals analytic de Rham via O_X^{dR}

test_3_rigid_analytic.name: rigid_vs_analytic_comparison_boundary
test_3_rigid_analytic.setup: X = rigid analytic space, embedded into analytic spaces
test_3_rigid_analytic.claim: structure sheaf of rigid X embeds into analytic O_X
